summary: EDENOR filed a Form 6-K reporting a partial cancellation of Class 3 and Class 5 Senior Notes after issuing Class 10, Series II notes in a private exchange. The new notes pay 9.5% fixed, mature April 28, 2033, for US$26.66M nominal, delivered as payment-in-kind for the cancelled notes. Cancelled: US$13.44M of Class 3 (US$82.32M remain) and US$11.82M of Class 5 (US$70.10M remain). This is a routine debt refinancing or exchange; no acquisition, tender offer, or special situation. Watch for further noteholder actions; no risk-arb angle.
